'''RX-7246''' was a custom-made [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was acquired by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Zayda]] for use as his personal [[Gladiator droid/Legends|combat assistant]]. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], RX-7246 and Zayda participated in a gladiatorial fight in [[Darga the Hutt's palace|the palace]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], fighting against the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Karg brothers]] and a group of undercover [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents.
